reviews.text: Hello. Thank you for saving Cachou in 2007 when he was a kitten. Thanks to you, he had the chance to live. He passed away on September 25, 2026. But he was lucky to have lived. Thank you.

Gentleness, attentiveness, and expertise are all present. The practice is pleasant, easily accessible, and very well-maintained. The staff knows how to handle both animals and people. I highly recommend them.
Very satisfied, the reception was excellent, and the veterinarian clearly explained my pet's problem and also advised me on the best diet for them.
He was very attentive and patient with us, as we had just gotten a kitten. He was very gentle with the animal, and overall it was incredibly reassuring to be able to trust someone so quickly.

We received a very warm welcome.
The vet gave us excellent advice.

Appointment for Leo on July 21st, 2024. The vet was very attentive, professional, and caring. It was my first time at this clinic, and I would definitely go back.

Thank you to the team 🙏
A fantastic team. A vet who takes the time to explain things to us. A lovely veterinary assistant. Thank you for everything, for us and especially for Mystic.
I recommend them without hesitation. A very good veterinarian with very pleasant and attentive staff who are non-judgmental.
Empathy for animals and their humans, the kind we would like to see in all veterinarians and veterinary nurses.
Very attentive, perfect
Finally, a real veterinarian, very gentle and respectful towards animals, quick appointment scheduling, and very reasonable prices. A big thank you! :)

The vet who treated my cat was super friendly.
A pleasant welcome.
Excellent care for the animals, and you can tell they love them.
Very good center.
I recommend it.
Satisfied

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.
The staff are kind, professional, and attentive.
Fantastic vet who takes the time to explain! Thank you!
Excellent welcome and service, the vet was attentive, calm and considerate.
Excellent care was provided for our cat who had an injured paw; our three cats have been treated at this clinic for several years now and we recommend it to others.
The vet is absolutely fantastic! He listens attentively, gives lots of great advice, and it's really pleasant to chat and laugh with the staff ☺️
Absolutely perfect, don't change a thing
Reliable, kind and always good with prices

Dr. Daeninckx is my dog ​​and cat's vet: Mike, a German Shepherd (not easy to treat), and Luffy.
He's so kind!

So calm!
He listens and is very patient.
Sylvaine is super friendly and very available.
A super professional team.
Everything goes well for my dwarf rabbit at each visit for about 4 years.

I highly recommend this practice. My dog ​​has been going there since she was a puppy and has no apprehension about going. The vet and his assistant go above and beyond for our animals while remaining gentle, responsive, and supportive. It's a real pleasure to have such excellent care for my dog.

Always very satisfied with the professionalism and dedication of the veterinary clinic.

A big thank you for all the excellent care provided 🥰👍 and advice.
Always a warm welcome, attentive listening, and excellent advice. A simple and calm atmosphere for treatments in complete confidence and serenity.
Great service and communication throughout.
Excellent advice. A very good veterinarian.

I highly recommend this welcoming and helpful veterinary practice, and above all, it's very competent. I would travel the distance again to have my animals treated by this veterinarian and his very pleasant assistant. Thank you to them!

My vet for years. I recommend him to many people because I know he's passionate and caring towards animals. I'm so glad I found such a great vet. When I go to his office, I feel completely reassured. A big thank you to you and your receptionist; you are both excellent and very attentive.

Well done! 👍

I've been taking my pets to this veterinary clinic for over 12 years and I'm delighted with the service. They truly listen and offer excellent advice. My cats and my dog ​​are always well cared for. Thank you for your professionalism and kindness.
A veterinarian who listens, is punctual, pleasant, and gives good advice.

As a long-time client, I'm very satisfied with this clinic. The receptionist is friendly, the veterinarian is competent and attentive to my animals' problems, and on top of that, he's very gentle with them. What more could you ask for? Reimbursement by social security... I haven't applied yet... lol
A very attentive and professional team whom we trust completely to take care of our kitten. Thank you for taking such good care of our animals!
A team attentive to the needs of the animals and the questions of their owners, warm and humane. A very respectful approach to the animals.
Excellent vet, very attentive, lets us make our own choices and gives us good advice.
Very good listener, gives good advice

Very nice practice. I used to go to another practice in Valmy (I won't name names) where I was very disappointed. So far, a pretty good first experience. They're understanding and take the time to listen... Well, not "see you next time," but I hope to see you less often ☺️

Two top-notch veterinarians!
A very pleasant first visit to this practice; they treated our little cat very well.
The veterinarian took the time to talk with us, explain the results and advise us on several things while remaining attentive.
This team is truly reassuring, both for us and our cat (it always feels so good at times like this), professional, friendly, and compassionate; we feel at home there!

I 100% recommend them if you need to bring your pets!

Difficult to reach by phone, we had to go there in person to make an appointment. It was quick; we got an appointment the next day. Very professional and attentive, taking the time to ask questions to fully understand the situation and provide excellent care for our cats.
I highly recommend them! Quick appointment and a super professional vet.
A competent, kind, and very gentle veterinarian with animals!
A fantastic vet, gentle and caring. He's been treating my dog ​​for several years. I highly recommend him!
Very satisfied, professional, and incredibly friendly
A truly wonderful vet and assistant! They've been treating our dog since he was two months old and they're so gentle with him! He loves going to see them :)
The vet who has been taking care of my dogs for a long time, very gentle with animals, and a very friendly assistant.
